description: KEGG ortholog inventory of the two spermidine routes in KT2440 with measured expression percentiles
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Re-verify the pathway gene inventory from KEGG (presence/absence of orthologs in ppu)
S=requests.Session()
def kegg_ko(ko):
    t=S.get(f"https://rest.kegg.jp/link/ppu/{ko}",timeout=60).text.strip()
    return [l.split("\t")[1].replace("ppu:","") for l in t.split("\n") if l]
KOs={"K01611 AdoMetDC (speD)":"ko:K01611","K00797 spermidine synthase (speE)":"ko:K00797",
     "K13745 DABA decarboxylase":"ko:K13745","K13746 CANSDH":"ko:K13746","K13747 CANSDC":"ko:K13747",
     "K01585 speA ADC":"ko:K01585","K01480 speB agmatinase":"ko:K01480","K01581 speC ODC":"ko:K01581",
     "K00133 asd":"ko:K00133"}
inv={}
for lab,ko in KOs.items():
    try: inv[lab]=kegg_ko(ko)
    except Exception as e: inv[lab]=["QUERY FAILED"]
    print(f"{lab:36s} -> {inv[lab]}")

d2=pd.read_csv("https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE322nnn/GSE322955/suppl/GSE322955_PP_log_tpm.csv.gz",
               compression="gzip",index_col=0)
mean=d2.mean(axis=1)
pct={g:100*(mean<mean[g]).mean() for g in ["PP_2929","PP_2928","PP_0567","PP_2196","PP_0864","PP_1867","PP_1989","PP_4523"] if g in mean.index}

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
labels=["speD AdoMetDC\n(K01611)","speE spermidine\nsynthase (K00797)","DABA decarboxylase\n(K13745)",
        "CASDH/CANSDH\nPP_2928","NspC decarboxylase\nPP_2929","speA (K01585)","speB (K01480)",
        "speC (K01581)","asd (K00133)"]
present=[0,0,0,1,1,1,1,1,1]
cols=["#c44536" if p==0 else "#2a6f97" for p in present]
ax.barh(np.arange(len(labels)),[1]*len(labels),color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(labels))); ax.set_yticklabels(labels,fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks([]); ax.invert_yaxis()
for i,p in enumerate(present):
    ax.text(0.5,i,"present" if p else "absent in KT2440",ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("A  Spermidine-route gene inventory, KT2440\n(KEGG ortholog query plus Pfam PF02675/PF17284 scan)",fontsize=10,loc="left")

ax=axes[1]
names={"PP_2929":"nspC","PP_2928":"PP_2928","PP_1989":"asd","PP_0864":"speC","PP_0567":"speA",
       "PP_4523":"PP_4523 agmatinase","PP_2196":"speB","PP_1867":"PP_1867 (PF01564,\nno SpeE N-domain)"}
ks=[k for k in names if k in pct]
vals=[pct[k] for k in ks]
o=np.argsort(vals)
ax.barh(np.arange(len(ks)),[vals[i] for i in o],
        color=["#2a6f97" if ks[i] in ("PP_2929","PP_2928") else "#9a9a9a" for i in o])
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(ks))); ax.set_yticklabels([names[ks[i]] for i in o],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("expression percentile, mean over 22 samples (GSE322955)")
ax.axvline(50,color="k",lw=0.8,ls=":")
ax.set_title("B  The NspC route is the well-expressed arm",fontsize=10,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nexpression percentiles:",{k:round(v,1) for k,v in pct.items()})
